newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto exchange reviewing Gandalf listing.
newsitem.headline: Toronto exchange reviewing Gandalf listing.

text.p: Toronto Stock Exchange officials are debating whether to stop listing the shares of troubled Gandalf Technologies Inc, under creditor protection since July 25.
"The exchange is reviewing the company for continued listing," said Toronto Stock Exchange spokesman Steve Kee on Tuesday.
Shares in the computer equipment maker, based near Ottawa, shed 0.14, or 35 percent, to 0.26 in heavy trading today.
Trading in Gandalf's shares on Nasdaq have been halted since July 25, after the market asked for more information.
